title: Logger saw the same craft in the area

tellings.quote: there was a there was a witness logger who had witnessed the this same craft up in that same area that they were logging.

plain: In the 1970s, a logger working near the Allagash Waterway, a stretch of wilderness rivers in Maine, is said to have seen the same craft that others reported in that area. A guest named Charlie Foltz, who presents himself as a witness to events there, passes on the logger's account second-hand. He tells it because a separate witness would back up what he and others say they saw.
